children: By Mireia Merino and Gemma  Guasch
Spanish online travel booking firm eDreams Odigeo

said on Tuesday its Prime subscriber base rose to 8.1 million members in the first quarter, as the subscription-led business model kept growing during what the company has described as its peak investment year.

The Barcelona-based company booked cash earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of €23.0 million ($26.7 million) for the April to June period, the first quarter of its accounting year, down 41% from a year earlier.
